entities.summary: Oliver Leon Robinson Jr is an American former basketball player who played shooting guard for the NBA's San Antonio Spurs. He later served as a Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives from 1998 to 2016, representing Alabama House District 58 (Birmingham).
